blocks.text: ABOARD THE PAPAL PLANE — Pope Leo XIV has forgiven the person who threw a rosary that nailed him in the eye before his final Mass in Peru, saying it was merely a sign of the person’s profound faith. Leo was hit during a popemobile ride Monday through the estimated 1.5 million people who had flooded a Lima air base for the service. Leo grimaced and touched his eye but proceeded as if nothing had happened.
